pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions of medium-to-dark brown. Edges exhibit soft gradients rather than sharp pixel transitions. Patch shapes on the lower neck and chest area show higher circularity, while those on the flank are more elongated and geometrically complex.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. The topology is characterized by frequent tri-point junction nodes. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, typically wider at junction points and narrower where two large patches are in close proximity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane visible along the superior neck boundary. The silhouette against the sky shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern consistent with uniform hair length.
